intent: Show a short line below a message's surface, such as its delivery status or actions on the message.
typical_uses: A delivery or read status below the bubble
A row of icon-only actions on the message

dont_use_when.situation: Reactions attached to the edge of the surface

invariants.text: The footer is a flex row that centers its children vertically, is inset var(--space-3) on the inline sides and renders in the meta text size at the label weight in var(--muted-foreground).
Under `align="end"` on the row the footer, as a direct child of MessageContent, is aligned to the end edge and justifies its own content to the end as well.
When anything in the row carries `data-variant="ghost"` (a Bubble with `variant="ghost"` stamps it), the footer's inline inset drops to zero so it sits flush with the frameless surface.

anti_patterns.dont: Render icon-only actions in the footer with no accessible name

good.title: A status line and a named icon-only action below the surface
good.code:
<MessageContent>
  <Bubble>
    <BubbleContent>Four files changed.</BubbleContent>
  </Bubble>
  <MessageFooter>
    Delivered
    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" icon={<CopyIcon />} aria-label="Copy message" />
  </MessageFooter>
</MessageContent>

bad.title: The footer placed above the surface
bad.why: MessageContent stacks its children in source order, so the footer renders above the bubble; it belongs after the surface.
